firm_data.firm_description: Larimer Law delivers legal services, consulting solutions, and thought leadership in eDiscovery, information governance and data privacy law. With offices in Rochester and Buffalo, New York, they serve corporate clients and law firms of all sizes and from a wide range of US and International jurisdictions.
notable_facts: Larimer Law has a sister company, Guru Discovery, for data processing and analytics services.
Larimer Law is known for its ability to scale teams to meet project needs.
technology_signals: Expertise in electronic discovery and document review services
Experience with Global Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
